limits: Primary 442 fixed seeds81–88: press goal difference +0.28125 to +0.375; counter -0.234375 to +0.375; lowBlock -0.078125 to -0.46875. This is not universal pressing reduction or complete four-way balance.

Validation 442 seeds701–704: fixed press +0.5 to -0.0625, counter -0.03125 to +1.09375; adaptive press base +0.5625 to -0.125, counter base -0.21875 to +1.0625. Counter strength and deep defensive cover remain tuning priorities.
Mean completed/tackle counts are simulator event counts, not a validated real football statistical model.
Strong starter squad campaign scores are not equal-strength tactic comparisons or isolated effect estimates.

433 seeds901–902 are a smaller sensitivity check. Rule13 lowBlock goal difference is +0.4375 fixed and +0.125 adaptive; this differs from weak 442 outcomes and does not establish a general best formation.

At ability80 seeds1001–1002, press overall goal difference remains +1.0625 fixed and changes +0.625 to +1.125 adaptive; lowBlock falls from +0.625 to -1.25 fixed and +0.4375 to -1.875 adaptive. Better press/counter pair symmetry does not establish healthy deep-defence balance.
excludedCandidates: Uniform shortened tackle reach weakened low-block defence.
Faster carrying/earlier releases/longer lead passes and general target clamping either worsened pressing bias or reduced constructive attacks.
These unpublished experiments are not additional released rule13 formats; the four final physical file hashes above identify this released implementation.
